title: Cancellation and No-Show Scale for the Hotel Rate Plans Range
content:
The penalty terms contracted for each plan of the Hotel Rate Plans range are set out below. The free-cancellation term is expressed in hours before arrival, the ladder in percentages of the room total by how far ahead of arrival the cancellation lands, and the flat terms in room nights or as a share of the room total.

**Free-cancellation term and flat penalty terms**

| Rate plan | Free cancellation, hours | Cancellation penalty, room nights | Cancellation penalty, share | No-show penalty, room nights | No-show penalty, share |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | 0 | 0 | 100 percent | 0 | 100 percent |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | 0 | 1 | 50 percent | 1 | 100 percent |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | 72 | 1 | 25 percent | 1 | 50 percent |
| Standard Flexible Rate | 24 | 1 | 10 percent | 1 | 25 percent |
| Member Flex Rate | 24 | 1 | 10 percent | 1 | 25 percent |
| Suite Flexible Rate | 48 | 2 | 20 percent | 2 | 50 percent |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | 168 | 3 | 35 percent | 3 | 100 percent |

**Cancellation ladder, as a share of the room total by days before arrival**

| Rate plan | 30 or more days | 29 to 8 days | 7 to 2 days | 1 or fewer days |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | 0 | 25 | 50 | 100 |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | 0 | 0 | 25 | 50 |
| Standard Flexible Rate | 0 | 0 | 0 | 10 |
| Member Flex Rate | 0 | 0 | 0 | 10 |
| Suite Flexible Rate | 0 | 0 | 10 | 20 |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | 0 | 10 | 20 | 35 |

Every figure in the ladder is a percentage of the room total. The free-cancellation figure is the number of hours before the arrival date by which a cancellation carries no penalty. The room-night figures are the room nights withheld as a penalty for a late cancellation or for a guest who never arrives; the share figures are the percentages of the room total withheld where the penalty is expressed as a share rather than as nights.

*Illustration of the ladder.* On the Suite Flexible Rate a cancellation landing 9 days before arrival falls in the 29 to 8 days band, where the ladder reads 0; landing 6 days before arrival it falls in the 7 to 2 days band, where the ladder reads 10.
